note: The CARICOM Single Market and Economy's free movement of skills: under Article 46 of the Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas, a national of a participating Member State who is an artiste or musician (among the approved categories) may seek work in any other participating state without a work permit, on a Certificate of Recognition of Caribbean Community Skills Qualification, with an indefinite stay subject to immigration requirements. The participating states for free movement: Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Belize, Dominica, Grenada, Guyana, Jamaica, St Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago (Trinidad and Tobago's Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs). The list gives no rule for other passports: each state keeping it gives its own.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs, Trinidad and Tobago: CSME – CARICOM Single Market and Economy
sources.said: CARICOM nationals who fall into any of the approved categories and wish to work in another participating CSME Member State must apply for and be granted a Certificate of Recognition of Caribbean Community Skills Qualification (Skills Certificate). A CARICOM national who has been issued with a Skills Certificate would be allowed an indefinite stay subject to all immigration requirements. ... The free movement of skills/labour includes the right of a CARICOM national under Article 46 of the Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas to seek work and/or engage in gainful employment in any of the participating CSME Member States, without the need to obtain a work permit in the Member State in which he/she wishes to work. ... Antigua and Barbuda Barbados Belize Dominica Grenada Guyana Jamaica St. Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia St. Vincent and the Grenadines Suriname Trinidad and Tobago. ... Artistes ... Musicians
